name: Porto Pub Crawl
description: A perfect way to meet new people and discover the city's best bars, this guided tour includes drinks, games, and VIP club entry.
longDescription:
The Porto Pub Crawl, scheduled for May 23, 2026, is a guided social event designed to introduce participants to Porto's evening entertainment scene. Organized by local nightlife enthusiasts, the crawl aims to facilitate connections among attendees while showcasing a selection of the city's popular drinking establishments. It provides a structured itinerary for exploring multiple venues in one evening.

Participants can expect an evening of social interaction and entertainment. The tour includes complimentary beverages at various stops and organized games to encourage group engagement. The experience culminates with VIP access to a club, allowing entry without standard queueing. The event is conducted in English, catering to an international audience interested in meeting new people and experiencing Porto's nightlife.

Tickets for the Porto Pub Crawl vary in price and can be purchased in advance. Specific meeting points are typically communicated upon booking. The event generally takes place in central Porto, an area well-served by public transport, including metro and bus lines.
